pre_execution_scope_detail: Route smoothing also uses its two endpoint boundary words, while replacement candidates retain full-board verification. GCC uninitialized attributes suppress automatic zeroing only for BFS routers/queues and height scratch arrays whose accessed entries are written by run before reading; required distance initialization is retained. No global disabling of automatic initialization. Added audit-only builds check background heights, invalid gaps, and incremental hash against full recomputation.
